description: This file defines the LogEntry interface, representing a connection log entry within a Java project. It includes method signatures for retrieving various properties of a log entry and inner classes for defining JSON schema fields related to log data.

classes.name: LogEntry
classes.description: An interface representing a connection log entry with methods to access log details like correlation ID, timestamp, category, type, level, message, address, and thing ID. It also provides JSON serialization functionalities.

methods.name: getCorrelationId
methods.description: Returns the correlation ID associated with the log entry.

methods.name: getTimestamp
methods.description: Returns the timestamp of when the log entry was created.

methods.name: getLogCategory
methods.description: Returns the category classification of the log entry.

methods.name: getLogType
methods.description: Returns the type classification of the log entry.

methods.name: getLogLevel
methods.description: Returns the severity level of the log entry.

methods.name: getAddress
methods.description: Returns an optional address related to the log, if available.

methods.name: getThingId
methods.description: Returns an optional ThingId related to the log, if applicable.

methods.name: toJson
methods.description: Serializes the log entry to a JSON object, including only non-hidden fields.

methods.name: toJson
methods.description: Serializes the log entry to a JSON object according to a specific schema version and field selector.
